mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DATAGEAR_AI_SESSION (AS_ID, AS_TITLE, AS_CREATE_USER_ID, AS_CREATE_TIME, AS_UPDATE_TIME) VALUES (#{entity.id}, #{entity.title}, #{entity.createUserId}, #{entity.createTime}, #{entity.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT A.AS_ID AS ${_iq_}id${_iq_}, A.AS_TITLE AS ${_iq_}title${_iq_}, A.AS_CREATE_USER_ID AS ${_iq_}createUserId${_iq_}, A.AS_CREATE_TIME AS ${_iq_}createTime${_iq_}, A.AS_UPDATE_TIME AS ${_iq_}updateTime${_iq_}, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DATAGEAR_AI_MESSAGE M WHERE M.AM_SESSION_ID = A.AS_ID AND M.AM_ROLE = 'user' ) AS ${_iq_}turns${_iq_} FROM DATAGEAR_AI_SESSION A WHERE A.AS_ID = #{id}

SELECT A.AS_ID AS ${_iq_}id${_iq_}, A.AS_TITLE AS ${_iq_}title${_iq_}, A.AS_CREATE_USER_ID AS ${_iq_}createUserId${_iq_}, A.AS_CREATE_TIME AS ${_iq_}createTime${_iq_}, A.AS_UPDATE_TIME AS ${_iq_}updateTime${_iq_}, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DATAGEAR_AI_MESSAGE M WHERE M.AM_SESSION_ID = A.AS_ID AND M.AM_ROLE = 'user' ) AS ${_iq_}turns${_iq_} FROM DATAGEAR_AI_SESSION A WHERE A.AS_CREATE_USER_ID = #{createUserId} ORDER BY A.AS_UPDATE_TIME DESC
